about: One-line requests and whether New robot keeps a person next to the robot, with its emergency stop (tests/test_brief_answers.py::test_the_people_hunt_table). From the round-6 release-review hunt (group hunt-*: 3,033 rows whose expectations were written before the hunt ran) and the fixer's own probes (fix-probe-*). expect: H someone it hands things to (hand-over, people yes or children, e-stop), HK a child it hands things to, P someone beside it, helped or served (people yes or children, e-stop), PK children, S a setting that leaves people around (people yes or children, e-stop), A an animal it works with (pets, yes or children, e-stop), N no one (no hand-over, and no person read from the words), NO 'nobody near it' (people no), X recorded only. known: why a row is still read otherwise, on purpose; the test expects it to stay so (strict xfail), so a change shows up and the docs' list of known misses is kept true.
